cf: CF is a radioactive transuranic element.
CF can also mean the most common hereditary disease.
CF means the same as californium or atomic number 98 or cf..
cfc: CFC is a fluorocarbon with chlorine.
For example: "The chlorine in CFCs causes depletion of atmospheric ozone."
CFC means the same as chlorofluorocarbon.
cfo: CFO is the corporate executive having financial authority to make appropriations and authorize expenditures for a firm.
CFO means the same as chief financial officer.
cftr: CFTR is the gene that is mutated in cystic fibrosis.
CFTR means the same as cystic fibrosis transport regulator.
Cf. means the same as cf.
